seeds.title: parse accepts non-ASCII digits in run and attempt tails
seeds.detail: Python \d matches unicode digits, so sdlc/run-١ and sdlc/S-001-attempt-１２ parse as run n=1 and attempt n=12. list returns them next to sdlc/run-1, so two branches claim one n, and name(run, n=1) does not give back the listed branch. The spec writes the regex as \d+, so this follows the text, and no requirement forbids it. Fix: use [0-9]+ or re.ASCII for the numeric parts in PARSE_ROWS.
